messages:
taylor: Heads-up — p99 for /v1/embeddings in the Rollouts pane spiked ~40% after the routing policy change, but the endpoint breakdown histogram doesn't show the same tail. anyone else seeing an alignment gap?

miriam: saw it, p50/p95 look fine. p99 is the odd one out. my suspicion is something with how we merge tdigest summaries across ingress vs worker shards.

reza: can you paste the console query or a sample request id? trying to reproduce locally.

taylor: sample request id: req_20250304_aa12. also including the console query we run for rollups:
```
SELECT quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(latency_ms) FROM traces WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND deployment='prod' GROUP BY route_rollout
```

sam: quick thought — did we change sampling at the ingress layer during the rollout? if ingress is downsampling long requests differently than workers, tdigest merge could bias the tail.

miriam: yes — rollout introduced adaptive-sampling to reduce cardinality for low-tier tenants. I flagged that but thought merge handled weights. maybe not for the extreme quantiles.

metrics-bot: deployment "rollout/route-policy-v3" started at 2025-03-04T15:02:11Z. sample_rate=0.2 for ingress-adaptive.

reza: that bot message lines up. tdigest needs sample weights preserved. if ingress drops 80% of long tails, merged tdigest will underrepresent tails and then p99 could flip either direction depending on which shard dominates.

sam: could also be retries being counted at ingress but dropped at worker-level metrics. double counting short retries would lower p99 at worker, raising discrepancy. check include_retries flag.

taylor: good call — console rollup query had include_retries=true by default. endpoint breakdown uses include_retries=false. that explains directionality.

miriam: so two issues: (1) sampling weight propagation across tdigest merges, (2) inconsistent include_retries between rollup and endpoint views.

reza: quick mitigation: set rollup query to include_retries=false and re-run, that should align numbers while we fix sampling semantics. I've also started a small script to recompute p99 from raw samples for a 1hr window to sanity-check.

sam: UI suggestion: show a small provenance pill next to each quantile (source: tdigest-merged | raw-samples) + sample_count. would prevent followup triage.

metrics-bot: ticket created: MET-2198 "Percentile provenance + sample count on latency panes" assigned to reza.

taylor: ty. reza — can you post the recompute results here when ready? if recompute matches endpoint breakdown we can close the panic.

reza: on it. running now, will post numbers in ~10m.

miriam: and I'll flip the rollout query in the console to include_retries=false as a temporary config change.

sam: cool. long-term: we should document merge semantics for tdigest in the telemetry runbook and add an automated alert when p99 diverges >25% between rollup vs raw endpoint. :eyes:
